pkgmetadata.longdescription: ggml is a library for performing tensor operations used by the ggml-org projects (llama.cpp, whisper.cpp, ...). This ebuild is an overlay of sci-ml/ggml::gentoo that adds the openblas, opencl and rpc backend flags.

use.flag: Enable the NVIDIA CUDA GPU backend
Use OpenMP in the CPU backend
Enable the AMD ROCm/HIP GPU backend
Enable the RPC backend for distributed inference
Install the internal headers and sources (src/ and include/) for packages that compile parts of ggml themselves, e.g. sci-misc/strata with system-ggml
